$comment: Logical signed public Publication model; public feeds are distinct from private OM ConversationEvents.

PublicationControlState.publisher_authority: principals allowed to authorize publication signing keys
PublicationControlState.signing_key_state: current/retired publication signing keys and rotation evidence
PublicationControlState.governance: authority/threshold required to change publication control state

PublicationEvent.clock: EventClock; display ordering only, never validity (ADR-0128 rule 13)
PublicationEvent.seq: per-signing-key monotonic counter; a post beyond the revoked key's last valid (key, seq) is invalid regardless of clock
PublicationEvent.prev_post_hash: hash of the previous event signed by the same key (per-key chain); absent only for seq 0
PublicationEvent.control_state_hash: hash of the PublicationControlState the signer acted under
PublicationEvent.signature: durable signature over canonical event encoding

Rule: Followers are not canonical Publication members. Mirrors may distribute posts but cannot forge publication authority. Retraction cannot guarantee erasure of already-public copies.

PublicationControlTransition.operation: profile/publisher/signing-key/discussion/governance operation; a signing-key revocation records last_valid: (signing_key_ref, seq)

ControlConflictRule: Authority/signing-key control forks freeze privileged advancement until resolved under common pre-fork governance; no relay/mirror/provider chooses the canonical authority head.
AntiRollbackRule: Subscribers keep the highest validated PublicationControlState head and reject older heads (ADR-0122 rule 6, ADR-0128 rule 13).
wire_note: Logical JSON remains a modeling view. Canonical interoperable bytes are frozen by ADR-0160 in spec/cddl/space-publication.cddl and the registries.
